company.name: Sav
company.shortDescription: Sav is a financial technology platform that provides personal finance management services, including account aggregation, spending analysis.
company.description: Sav is the GCC's ultimate money app, designed to help users understand money, protect & grow wealth, and manage debt. Built on the foundations of Open Banking, Sav uses Ai to suggest users to the shortest, most efficient path to their money goals. Our mission is to help everyone live beyond the next paycheck, implementing AI effectively to help our users feel less stressed about their money.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,476,741 to $17,000,000, a 2.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
